description: Create deployment documentation (mobile/EAS_SETUP.md) explaining EAS project ID setup, and add a .gitignore entry for the .agents/ directory to prevent task tracking files from being committed in the future.
steps: Create mobile/EAS_SETUP.md with clear step-by-step instructions for: 1) Installing EAS CLI (npm install -g eas-cli), 2) Running 'eas init' to generate the real projectId, 3) Replacing the placeholder in app.json, 4) Building a preview APK with 'eas build --profile preview --platform android', 5) Note about the owner being 'erbhaweshkafle' and slug being 'artnepalaya-mobile'.
Add .agents/ to the root .gitignore file. If .gitignore does not exist at the repo root, create it. This prevents future task tracking files from being committed.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/EAS_SETUP.md exists with clear, actionable deployment steps
verification: Verify mobile/EAS_SETUP.md exists and is non-empty
findings: Created mobile/EAS_SETUP.md with full step-by-step EAS setup instructions. Updated root .gitignore to add .agents/ entry and .env.production (was previously un-ignored via !.env.production). Removed the !.env.production exception per the briefing requirement that .env.production contains secrets and should be ignored.
